نشته (form VIII)
# نَشْتَهِ (naštahi) /naʃ.ta.hi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
# نُشْتَهَ (nuštaha) /nuʃ.ta.ha/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
